$schema.description: Relative path or URL to the JSON schema definition file.

specsDir.description: Path to the directory containing feature specifications. Supports tokens {projectRoot} and {skillsRoot}.

scoreMin.description: Minimum conformance score (0-10) required before creating delivery commits.

models.description: Advisory per-role model hints interpreted by the host harness. Hints carry opaque identifiers only; helpers never invoke a model, call a provider API, or store credentials.

default.description: Fallback hint applied when the role-specific entry is null or absent.

orchestrator.description: Hint for Steps 1-3 derivation, refinement grilling, DAG generation, and run supervision.

worker.description: Hint for Step 4 task implementation subagents.

reviewer.description: Hint for the Step 7 fresh reviewer subagent.

fixer.description: Hint for fixer remediation in Step 7 fix iteration and Step 8 convergence fixes.

judge.description: Hint for Step 5 conformance scoring; resolved before the legacy scoring.judge* keys.

ship.description: Hint for Step 8 PR metadata and review convergence dialogue; falls back to the fixer hint.

retro.description: Hint for retro analysis; falls back to the default hint.

detection.description: Opt-in start-of-run host capability detection. Disabled by default so runs resolve hints statically.

enabled.description: Bind capabilities once at run start before task dispatch.

command.description: Optional command that writes the capabilities JSON file. Supports {capabilitiesFile}, {targetRoot}, {slug}, {runId}. When null, the host consults its harness.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum detection command runtime in milliseconds.

scoring.description: Configuration for Step 5 LLM-judge conformance scoring (Spec 027).

judgeCommand.description: Optional command that judges conformance and writes the verdict JSON. Supports {promptFile}, {verdictFile}, {diffFile}, {criteriaFile}, {slug}, {targetRoot}. When null, the current agent model instance judges and submits the verdict via 'score submit'.

judgeModel.description: Judge model identifier passed to the judge command or the host agent.

judgeProvider.description: Judge provider identifier passed to the judge command or the host agent.

judgeEffort.description: Judge reasoning-effort hint passed to the judge command or the host agent.

judgeApiEndpoint.description: Judge API endpoint passed to the judge command or the host agent.

judgeCriticity.description: Judge strictness: permissive credits partial attempts, strict requires the demanded behaviour, perfectionist requires complete implementation with verification.

retro.description: Automatic retrospective after a run reaches completed (spec 00045).

enabled.description: When true, sdw-orch runs sdw-retro for the completed run and records the outcome in state.retro. When false or absent, it prints the advisory retro command only.

followUp.description: sdw-batch policy for the retrospective candidates of a completed item: queue (create draft specs for critical/high candidates and append them to the batch queue), record (write .sdw/state/batch-{batchId}.followups.md and create nothing), or none (read no report). Follow-up items (followUpDepth 1) still record their candidate summary but never queue more specifications.

transcripts.description: Explicit transcript files the retrospective scans line by line for sdw-orch command signatures. Supports the {projectRoot} token; project-relative paths stay inside the project root. Empty by default: transcripts are never discovered.

scmCodeReviewEnabled.description: Enable remote pull request review polling loop and automated review comment resolution.

pushDelivery.description: Automatically push the delivery commit and branch to remote origin upon workflow completion.

changelogEnabled.description: Enable appending delivery records to the project changelog. When false, sdw-changelog exits 0 with 'skipped: disabled' and writes nothing.

changelogFile.description: Path to the project changelog. Supports the {projectRoot} token; the resolved path must stay inside the project root.

stateDir.description: Path to the directory storing run session state files. Supports tokens {projectRoot} and {skillsRoot}.

monitor.description: Live run monitor (spec 00021). Every value is a positive integer count of seconds.

stallWindowSeconds.description: Age in seconds after which a non-terminal run whose newest state and telemetry clock stopped advancing is classified 'stalled'.

lockStaleMs.description: Age in milliseconds after which an abandoned run lock ({stateFile}.lock) may be reclaimed, and only when the recorded owner process is proven absent. A younger lock always blocks mutation.

sandboxDir.description: Path to the directory that holds sandbox clones created by sdw-orch --sandbox. Defaults to {projectRoot}/.sdw/sandbox; any other value must resolve outside the project root. Supports tokens {projectRoot}, {skillsRoot}, and {temp}.

skillsRoot.description: Path to the active skills directory. Supports tokens {projectRoot} and {skillsRoot}.

autoResolveGaps.description: Automatically apply recommended defaults for unhandled grilling gaps when running non-interactively.

securityChecksEnabled.description: Enable pre-commit secrets and credentials leak scanning.

useWorktrees.description: Enable per-task isolated git worktrees for dispatched subagents under .sdw/worktrees/{runId}/.

useFeatureBranches.description: Automatically create and activate an isolated feature branch derived from specification slug.

branching.description: Branch lane model (spec 00040): the work lane is where feature branches start and where the repository returns after delivery; the integration lane is where the pull request merges. `strategy` selects a preset and every explicit key overrides that preset.

strategy.description: Preset: trunk (feature branches start from the checked-out branch), github (work lane mirrors the integration lane), develop (feature branches start from develop; pull requests target the auto-detected integration branch), gitflow (feature branches start from develop and pull requests merge into develop), gitlab (work lane mirrors the integration lane; promotions between environment lanes stay manual).

featurePrefix.description: Prefix for the feature branch name: {branching.featurePrefix}{specSlug}.

workBranch.description: Branch where feature branches start and where the repository returns after delivery. null uses the checked-out branch; the github and gitlab presets mirror integrationBranch.

integrationBranch.description: Branch that receives the pull request merge. null means auto: the repository default branch resolved from origin/HEAD.

updateWorkBranch.description: Fetch origin and fast-forward the work branch before creating the feature branch.

syncWorkBranchAfterMerge.description: After the pull request merges, fast-forward the work branch to the integration branch.

pushSyncedWorkBranch.description: Push the synchronized work branch to origin after the post-merge fast-forward.

scmProvider.description: Configured SCM provider for issues, work items, and pull requests. Allowed: none, ado, github.

implementation.description: Configuration for task implementation execution in Step 4.

mode.description: Implementation execution mode: subagent (sequential host-dispatched workers, one task at a time) or command (automated subprocess per task).

command.description: Command to execute when implementation.mode is command.

timeoutMs.description: Execution timeout in milliseconds for command mode.

envAllowlist.description: List of allowed environment variable names.

verification.description: Configuration for build and test gates in Step 4.

buildCommand.description: Command executed for build verification gate.

testCommand.description: Command executed for test verification gate.

freshVerifyEnabled.description: Run fresh-context verification between Step 4 evidence acceptance and Step 5 scoring. Disabled by default; when enabled, scoring is blocked until one verdict per acceptance criterion is accepted.

requiredBuild.description: Enforce successful build verification before creating delivery commit or PR.

buildCommand.description: Command to execute for build verification.

runAllTests.description: Enforce passing all test suites before creating delivery commit or PR.

testCommand.description: Command to execute for test verification pass.

prePrCommand.description: Optional project-specific shell command to execute before PR preparation (e.g. version bump, lint).

prePrInstructions.description: Optional project-specific instructions or checklist for agents to verify prior to PR submission.

prePrDiscovery.description: Controls the pre-PR discovery scan of repo-root AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, RELEASE.md, and PUBLISH.md plus prePrInstructions: block refuses the push and pull request until --ack-prepare is supplied, warn prints the discovered obligations and continues, off skips the scan. Absent resolves to block.

reviewFixCommand.description: Optional command that applies review-thread fixes. When unset, sdw-ship-pr never resolves active threads automatically.

maxPreemptions.description: Maximum concurrent-push adaptation budget for post-PR review convergence before draining rounds.

maxTasksPerSpec.description: Task cap per specification that the DAG planner enforces; out-of-range values clamp to 2-8.

memory.description: Product memory backend selection for sdw-memory (central knowledge wrapper). The ws-memo vault is the default integration; local traps file and memory files are fallbacks.

backends.description: Enable or disable each memory store backend. Missing keys default to enabled.

wsMemo.description: Use the ws-memo vault (memo CLI) as the default knowledge store.

files.description: Search local MEMORY.md and memory/*.md files (read-only).

modelHint.description: Advisory model hint passed through verbatim to the host harness.

effort.description: Reasoning-effort token passed through verbatim (for example high, medium, low).
